title: Takarakuji
tagline: DApp that Let's you play Takarakuji scratch-off online uses ZK rollups
description:
This DApp uses an L2 to resolve winning tickets and sends them to L1 for the winner to be notified and have crypt paid out to their wallet. Implements a social leaderboard of wallets that have won with lens. The Linea Metamask testnet is used for ZK rollups. 

Made with wagmi react, typescript, solidity.
how_its_made: This DApp uses an L2 to resolve winning tickets and sends them to L1 for the winner to be notified and have crypt paid out to their wallet.
